row.title: Tenant liveness hid a dead loop (What Works launch)
row.body: On What Works' launch /health said ok while every OpenAlex call answered 429 and every Europe PMC call 503, so no programme was ever checked; overlapping catch-up beats from visits caused the burst and duplicate first grades. Liveness must report each part of the loop with its own ok, and the platform reads every tenant's parts live (tenantrepos --health, detector tenant-health). A tenant merge now ships within the hour via the tick's tenant-deploy step.
